Class OfferTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.tile.OfferTile
public class OfferTile extends Object
Represents a single offer tile on the offer track. Each tile has a unique identifier, pick limits for the upper and lower card rows, a food reward granted on first action resolution, and a minimum player count.

A tile can be occupied by at most one player at a time.

  • Constructor Details

    • OfferTile

      public OfferTile(char tileID, int minPlayers, int gainedFood, int numUpperChoosable, int numLowerChoosable)
      Parameters:
      tileID - the unique single-character identifier for this tile (e.g. 'A')
      minPlayers - minimum player count required for this tile to be in play
      gainedFood - food points granted to the player on their first action from this tile
      numUpperChoosable - maximum cards the player may pick from the upper row
      numLowerChoosable - maximum cards the player may pick from the lower row
